description: List every card in a group, whether it stands on a board or in the group's backlog (a board-less card, columnId null). Use this to discover backlog cards — no other list surfaces them. `placement` narrows to board|backlog|all (default all).

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous page of this same list.

limit.description: Page size (max 200). Omitted: the whole collection, one response.

updatedSince.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — only cards changed after it.

name: zuuna_list_group_cards
